name: job_board
description: Added a status filter to search_jobs so callers can choose which job states to surface instead of always filtering on 'published'. handle_search was updated to pass the new argument, but the other two callers were missed.
flaw: search_jobs in db.py gained a new REQUIRED parameter 'status' with no default. Only handle_search in main.py was updated to pass it; handle_homepage and handle_alert_digest still call search_jobs with the old two-argument signature. Both call sites now raise TypeError: search_jobs() missing 1 required positional argument: 'status' at runtime, breaking the homepage and alert digest endpoints.
